📖 Core Definitions

Essential Terminology & Concepts

A Full Binary Tree Core Definition

A Full Binary Tree a tree where every node has either 0 or 2 children.

Raversing General Trees Traversal Core Definition

Raversing General Trees Traversal visiting all nodes of the tree in a specific order.

General Trees Key Concept

Establishes essential concepts, mathematical or computational foundations, and techniques of general trees.

Binary Trees Key Concept

In Binary tree data structure each node has left child node and right child node.

Implementing Trees Key Concept

To implement a general tree in Python, we can create a `Node` class to represent each node in the tree.

📌 Key Takeaways

Section-by-Section Study Breakdown

8.2 General Trees

  • Establishes essential concepts, mathematical or computational foundations, and techniques of general trees.
  • Applies standard methodologies relevant to modern data science workflows and analysis in trees.

8.3 Binary Trees

  • In Binary tree data structure each node has left child node and right child node.
  • BINARY TREES: DEFINITION AND STRUCTURE A node of binary tree consist of - - A data element.
  • - A reference to the left child (which is also a binary tree).
  • - A reference to the right child (which is also a binary tree).

8.4 Implementing Trees

  • To implement a general tree in Python, we can create a `Node` class to represent each node in the tree.
  • Each node will hold data and a list of its children.
  • TREE TRAVERSAL: DEFINITION AND IMPORTANCE Tree traversal refers to the process of visiting all the nodes in a tree data structure in a systematic manner.
  • The order in which nodes are visited can significantly affect the performance of operations such as searching and sorting.

8.5 Tree Traversal Algorithms

  • We shall look at various traversal algorithms in this section.
  • TREE TRAVERSAL: DEFINITION AND IMPORTANCE Tree traversal refers to the process of visiting all the nodes in a tree data structure in a systematic manner.
  • The order in which nodes are visited can significantly affect the performance of operations such as searching and sorting.
  • The main types of tree traversal algorithms are: - Depth-First Traversal: Visits nodes along a branch before backtracking.

8.6 Case Study: An Expression Tree

  • In computer science, expression trees are a specialized form of binary trees used to represent expressions.
  • Each internal node corresponds to an operator, while the leaf nodes represent operands.
  • We can efficientlyevaluate expressions and is widely used in compilers and interpreters.
  • EXPRESSION TREES: DEFINITION AND STRUCTURE An expression tree is a binary tree where: - Each internal node represents an operator (e.g., +, -, *, /).
⚡ Laws & Formulas

Governing Equations, Complexity & Rules

Insertion: O(n) for a basic binary tree
Searching: O(n) for a basic binary tree
Traversal: O(n) for all methods
tree using level-order insertion? a) O(1) b) O(log n) c) O(n) d) O(n^2)
a. Answer: c) O(n) Explanation: Level-order insertion requires
